calls.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.redline-uv-', dir=Path.cwd()) as redline_uv_tmp:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(TMPDIR=redline_uv_tmp, UV_NO_CACHE='1', UV_NO_PROJECT='1')
    result = subprocess.run(['uv', 'run', str(Path('.agents/skills/redline/scripts/invoke.py').resolve())], input='--output=response input.md\n', text=True, env=env)
    raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
PY","max_output_tokens":6000}));
